capabilities: Zoom image files with trackpad pinch on macOS
Pinch-zoom with two fingers on iPad and iPhone
Zoom with a modifier key plus scroll wheel
Pan zoomed images by dragging, clamped to image edges
Reset zoom with double-click or double-tap
disambiguation: Only affects images opened directly in their own tab; images embedded inside markdown notes are not touched.
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin directory; installation is via manual download until acceptance, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian opens image files at fixed scale with no way to zoom in on details using trackpad pinch or modifier-scroll gestures.
summary: Adds pinch-zoom and modifier-scroll zoom with panning to image files opened in their own Obsidian tab.
